race.comment: HERE COMES WOZZA (7) is a locally trained gelding resuming from a spell, and his only career win came fresh up. He has won a recent jump-out on his home course, and from a sweet gate, he gets a big chance to add another win to his tally. WESTERN LANE (10) did not cope with a heavy track when ending his last season, and he has had 3 jump-outs to prepare for his return, winning the most recent of those this month. Don't take him lightly fresh. SACRED CHORD (6) has maintained his form in some tougher fields, and there is no reason why he can't run another honest race in this, especially from the pole position. TALLINGAS INDIROSE (16) resumes from a spell, and is one to include in all combos at a price. TRUE PROPHET (13) can't be faulted recently in similar fields to this, and another honest effort can be expected.
